newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Boram Bank closes US$80 mln FRN.
newsitem.headline: Boram Bank closes US$80 mln FRN.

text.p: Boram Bank's US$80 million floating rate note issue has been allotted, arranger Standard Chartered Investment Banking said on Wednesday.
The facility has a final maturity of three years and annual put options.
The issue was priced at par to float at 30 basis points over the six-month London Interbank Offered Rate for the first year and at LIBOR plus 37.5 basis points thereafter.
Full fees are four basis points.
Arrangers, with US$15 million each, are Sanwa International Fianance and Standard Chartered Investment Banking.

Co-lead managers, with US$5 million each, are ABN Amro Hoare Govett, Bank Austria Aktiengesellschaft Hong Kong, Banque et Caisse d'Epargne de l'Etat Singapore, Deutsche Morgan Grenfell, EFIBANCA S.p.A, KDB Bank UK, Landesbank Scheleswig-Holstein Luxembourg Branch, LTCB Asia, Union Bank of Switzerland Hong Kong and Yamaichi International Hong Kong.
